name: New Firewall Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
description: Detects the addition of a new rule to the Windows firewall via netsh
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:*\\netsh.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:netsh.exe) AND (process.command_line:*\ firewall\ * AND process.command_line:*\ add\ *)) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*advfirewall\ firewall\ add\ rule\ name\=Dropbox\ dir\=in\ action\=allow\ \"program\=?\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Dropbox\\Client\\Dropbox.exe\"\ enable\=yes\ profile\=Any* OR *advfirewall\ firewall\ add\ rule\ name\=Dropbox\ dir\=in\ action\=allow\ \"program\=?\:\\Program\ Files\\Dropbox\\Client\\Dropbox.exe\"\ enable\=yes\ profile\=Any*)))
